title: Product Interaction: An Algebraic Formalism for Deep Learning Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2602.02573v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern neural architectures are largely developed as distinct empirical constructions, despite recurring principles across convolutional, attention, state-space, and equivariant models. We introduce Product Interactions, an algebraic formalism that unifies these architectures under a common construction principle and turns their design into a systematic procedure. The core shift is representing data as algebraic elements and treating multiplication, rather than linear transformation alone, as a primitive architectural operation. Architectures are generated by composing multiplication operators, with input dependence organized by self-interaction order. Within this formalism, we derive convolutional and equivariant networks as symmetry-constrained first-order product interactions, recover Mamba from state-space models as an increase in self-interaction order from one to three, and establish attention as a third-order interaction

translated_title: 乘积交互：一种面向深度学习架构的代数形式化方法
translated_abstract: 现代神经架构在很大程度上是作为各自独立的经验性构建而发展起来的，尽管卷积、注意力、状态空间和等变模型中存在反复出现的基本原理。我们引入了乘积交互，这是一种代数形式化方法，它在共同的构建原则下统一了这些架构，并将其设计转化为系统化的流程。其核心转变在于将数据表示为代数元素，并将乘法（而不仅仅是线性变换）作为基本的架构操作。架构通过组合乘法算子来生成，输入依赖性由自交互阶数来组织。在这一形式化框架内，我们将卷积网络和等变网络推导为受对称性约束的一阶乘积交互，从状态空间模型中恢复了Mamba（解释为自交互阶数从一阶提升到三阶），并确立了注意力机制作为一种三阶交互。
tldr: 本文提出“乘积交互”这一代数形式化框架，将乘法而非仅线性变换作为基本架构操作，通过自交互阶数统一了卷积网络、注意力机制、状态空间模型（如Mamba）和等变网络，使深度学习架构设计成为系统化流程。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Product Interactions, an algebraic formalism that treats multiplication as a primitive architectural operation, unifying convolutional, attention, state-space (Mamba), and equivariant networks under a single systematic design principle organized by self-interaction order.
